title: Suspicious LSASS Handle Access Variant
content: A workstation alert says an unusual admin tool opened lsass.exe with high access rights. The command line includes procdump.exe -ma lsass.exe and a dump file appears before the same user authenticates to another server.

expected.threat_summary: A non-standard process accesses LSASS memory and may dump credentials before follow-on authentication.
key_behaviors: non-standard process opens LSASS with high privileges
dump file is created from LSASS memory
follow-on authentication occurs after credential access
hunt_checklist: Review EDR process telemetry for procdump/comsvcs/nanodump access to LSASS.
Check dump file creation on the same host and user.
Review follow-on authentication or lateral movement after LSASS access.
expected.correlation_logic: Correlate LSASS process access, dump file creation, user, host, and follow-on authentication in the same time window.
expected.escalation_condition: Escalate when LSASS access is not approved security tooling or is followed by credential use.
expected.analyst_notes: Hand-authored external gold standard case for accuracy/generalization evaluation.
